page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor operating at a baseline clock speed of 2.55 GHz. Built on KVM hypervisor architecture, it provides 32 physical cores configured as 64 dedicated vCPUs with 2.0 threads per core. System memory totals 128 GB, establishing a 2.0 GB RAM per vCPU ratio. Network performance is backed by a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The instance features no local storage and relies entirely on external block storage services. Hardware flags support instruction sets including AVX, AES, VAES, SHA_NI, BMI2, and FMA.

Performance benchmark results place the instance in the top 25% for stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU evaluations, PassMark CPU scoring, hardware encryption, and image processing. Small-block cached memory bandwidth reaches 4132.73 GB/sec, placing it in the upper quartile, whereas uncached large-block memory read (85.04 GB/sec) and write (38.03 GB/sec) speeds operate within average industry ranges. LLM prompt processing and text generation for small 135M parameter models show strong performance, while medium 7B parameter models operate at average throughput levels.

The hardware configuration emphasizes high parallel compute capacity relative to memory volume. This profile provides qualitative cost efficiency for compute-intensive execution paths that do not require high RAM-per-core ratios or direct-attached NVMe storage. Primary workload fits include batch processing, continuous integration software compilation, database management operations, image processing pipelines, and lightweight machine learning inference.
